extracted.intended_audience: Crossref members, preprint publishers, metadata managers, librarians, and publishers using Crossref services
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and announcement about supporting preprint metadata registration and DOI assignment in Crossref, and how that affects CitedBy metadata retrieval via Crossref's OAI-based API. Covers what metadata members will see when preprints that cite other works are deposited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprint metadata registration and DOI assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes will allow preprint publishers to register their metadata with Crossref and assign DOIs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The blog announces that Crossref is finalising changes so preprint publishers can deposit metadata and mint DOIs for preprints (full preprint support to be released soon). This enables preprints to be persistently identified within Crossref's infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for CitedBy linking between preprints and other scholarly publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Crossref will support CitedBy linking between preprints and other scholarly publications (journal articles, books, conference proceedings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly states the purpose of preprint DOI/metadata support is to enable Crossref’s CitedBy links connecting preprints with other types of scholarly output, improving discoverability and relationship tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: OAI-based CitedBy API will identify the record type of citing content
rubrics_metrics.description: Results returned by Crossref's OAI-based CitedBy service will include the type of content that is doing the citing (the record type).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The blog notes a change to the OAI service: members using the OAI-based API to retrieve CitedBy links will see data that identifies each citing item's record type alongside its DOI (example: showing that DOI X is cited by five items and displaying the DOIs of those items and their record type).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the cr_citedby metadataPrefix with OAI ListRecords to retrieve CitedBy links
rubrics_metrics.description: Members can retrieve large quantities of data detailing all the CitedBy links to a given publication via the OAI handler using metadataPrefix=cr_citedby.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example request provided: http://oai.crossref.org/OAIHAndler?verb=ListRecords&usr=*** pwd=****&set=B:10.1109:1070762&metadataPrefix=cr_citedby. The example demonstrates pulling CitedBy data for a given item (an IEEE conference proceeding) and receiving citing DOIs and record types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposited preprint metadata should include references to works it cites
rubrics_metrics.description: When preprint content that cites other scholarly work is registered with Crossref, members will see the CitedBy data for those references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement: for preprints to appear as citers in Crossref CitedBy data, preprint metadata deposits must include the references/citation data of works they cite; once deposited, those citations will be surfaced via the OAI CitedBy service.
